security_identification.value: Deferred Interest Bonds due July 1, 2034, 11.000%, CUSIP FQ4TWLB23

interest_type.excerpt: Interest on the Deferred Interest Bonds will not be paid currently but will accrue and be compounded semiannually on each January 1 and July 1

interest_rate_pct.excerpt: The Deferred Interest Bonds will bear interest at the rate of 11.000% per annum from the Dated Date.

compounding_frequency.excerpt: will accrue and be compounded semiannually on each January 1 and July 1, commencing January 1, 2020

day_count.excerpt: Interest on the Deferred Interest Bonds shall be computed on the basis of a 360-day year consisting of twelve 30-day months.

accrual_start_date.excerpt: The Series 2019 Bonds will be dated their date of delivery, which is expected to be July 1, 2019 (the "Dated Date").

payment_dates.value: at maturity or upon prior redemption
payment_dates.excerpt: will be payable, together with the principal thereof, only at maturity or upon prior redemption

first_compounding_date.excerpt: compounded semiannually on each January 1 and July 1, commencing January 1, 2020 (each, a "Compounding Date")

call_features.description: Optional redemption on or after July 1, 2029 at Accreted Value, without premium
call_features.excerpt: The Deferred Interest Bonds are subject to optional redemption prior to maturity in whole or in part on any date on or after July 1, 2029, at a redemption price equal to the Accreted Value thereof

call_features.description: Extraordinary mandatory redemption from prepayments of Special Assessments
call_features.excerpt: The Series 2019 Bonds are subject to extraordinary mandatory redemption in whole or in part on any Interest Payment Date from prepayments of Special Assessments

notes: Interest accrues from the Dated Date and compounds semiannually; nothing is paid before maturity or redemption. Appendix E provides an accreted value table per $5,000 principal.
